_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 2: pick-up effects ($86BC-$87EB). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): item < 11?
regions.description: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): item ids 0-10 are the eleven upgradable weapons (weapon = id + 1, the icon numbers of the status screen); 11 is the Enemy Eraser; 12-17 are the six power-ups; 18 and over are the item-box drops. `$10` := the id; 11 or more branches to `$8711`.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): weapon: which level byte
regions.description: Y := id / 4 (the byte `$04AC + Y`), X := id mod 4 (the pair of bits): the 11 weapons' levels are two bits each in `$04AC-$04AE`.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): weapon: already at level 3?
regions.description: The byte AND the mask `$87C6[X]` equal to the mask means both bits set: level 3.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): weapon at level 3: chips instead
regions.description: `$4D` (the chip count's high byte) += 7 (so +1,792 chips, capped at CHIP MAX), capped at `$FF`, and a chip add of 0 with sound `$D4`-argument through `$C12F` (`$FCE7`, which redraws and re-derives the gun tier). RUN: items 0, 3 and 10 with all weapons at level 3 filled the chips from 100 to CHIP MAX (500 in the run: the add is capped).

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): weapon: one level up
PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): weapon: the chips redraw, and the sprite tiles
regions.description: A chip add of 0 (`$FCE7`: redraw the counter, set the gun tier); if the id + 1 equals the selected weapon `$3C`, `JSR $C069` (`$F726`) reloads that weapon's sprite tiles for the new level.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): sound
regions.description: Sound `$35` (the weapon / upgrade jingle).

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): +16 life
regions.description: `A := $10`, `JMP $C00C` (`$FD67`, add A to the life). **Every upgrade gives 16 life.** RUN: life 32 -> 48 for ids 0-11, 14-16, 21.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): return
regions.description: RTS.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): item 11: the Enemy Eraser
regions.description: `$04AE` bit 6 set (the Eraser is owned) and `$04AF` (its stock) += 20, capped at `$FF`, then the weapon ending `$86F3`. RUN: stock 3 -> 23 and `$04AE` 21 -> 85.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): items 12 and up: sound
regions.description: A is Y. The sound `$87BB[id - 12]` (`32 00 35 35 35 31 00 00 30 34 33`) is played when non-zero; ids under 13 take the life refill.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): item 12: Energy Tank icon - full life
regions.description: `$48` := `$47`: life becomes the maximum. No +16. RUN: 32 -> 128.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): item 13: Blue Lander - the Energy Tank effect
regions.description: `JSR $C033` (`$DF8C`, the score-bonus award: chips refilled to CHIP MAX, max life +8, life full, song `$31`) then +16 life. RUN: max life 128 -> 136, life 32 -> 136, chips 100 -> 500.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): item 14: Gun - attack +1
PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): item 15: Shield - shield +1
regions.description: `$4B` += 1 when it is not 0 (a zero shield stays 0).

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): attack / shield tail
regions.description: `JSR $C132` (`$FD0E`: the attack is capped at 4 and the player's attack `$05A8` is looked up in `$FD4B`) then +16 life. RUN: attack 1 -> 2, shield 1 -> 2.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): item 16: Consecutive Firing - fire rate +1
regions.description: `$6B` += 1, capped at 5; `JSR $882E` loads the shot delay `$39` := `$87CE[$6B]` (`0C 05 04 03 02 01`); +16 life. RUN: 1 -> 2.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): item 17: Red Lander - chip capacity +1
regions.description: `$46` += 1 (capped at 10); `JSR $8820` takes CHIP MAX `$4E/$4F` from `$87D4[level]` (50, 100, 150, 200, 400, 800, 1200, 1600, 2400, 4000, 6000, 30000); the chips and the life are filled to their maxima. RUN: level 1 -> 2, CHIP MAX 500 -> 150, chips 100 -> 150, life 32 -> 128 (no +16).

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): items 18-20: +40 life
regions.description: Under 21: `LDA #$28 / JSR $C00C`: life += 40, no +16. Item 20 also plays sound `$30` from the table. RUN: ids 18, 19, 20 gave +40.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): item 21: 500 chips
regions.description: `$4D` += 1 (+256) and `$FCE7` with A = `$F4` (+244): +500 chips, capped at CHIP MAX; then +16 life. RUN: chips 100 -> 500 (the cap), life +16, sound `$34`.

regions.name: PICK-UP EFFECTS (bank 2 slot `$8015` -> `$86BC`; A = the item id; also reached from the shop and the reward screens): items 22 and up: 10 chips, +8 life
regions.description: A chip add of 10 and life += 8. RUN: 22 gave chips 100 -> 110, life +8, sound `$33`.

regions.name: Pick-up sounds for items 12-22
Weapon level masks
Weapon level steps
Shot delay by fire rate
CHIP MAX by chip level (12 x 16 bits)
regions.description: `50, 100, 150, 200, 400, 800, 1200, 1600, 2400, 4000, 6000, 30000`; the level stops at 10, so the last value is never reached by an upgrade.

regions.name: Item id test
regions.description: A := `$0680,X` (the object's item), `CMP #$14`, RTS: carry set for the box-drop ids from 20 up.

regions.name: Break the block under the object
Spark through bank 1
regions.description: `$19` := A and a far call (inline `01 02 80`) to bank 1 `$8003`.

regions.name: Spark: return
regions.description: RTS.

regions.name: CHIP MAX from the chip level
Shot delay from the fire rate
